steps.name: Step 1: Verify initial cart state — Espresso x1, subtotal $10.00
Step 2: Click '+' twice — quantity should become x3, subtotal $30.00
Clicking plus button 2 times for item: Espresso
Step 3: Verify cart total at bottom updates to $30.00
Getting total price from the checkout button
Step 4: Click '-' once — quantity should become x2, subtotal $20.00
Clicking minus button for item: Espresso
Step 5: Verify cart total at bottom decreases to $20.00
Getting total price from the checkout button
